title: AI-Simplified Discharge Summaries to Improve Patient Comprehension (ContextCare)
official: ContextCare: A Randomized Pilot Trial of AI-simplified Discharge Summaries to Improve Patient Comprehension
summary: This randomized pilot study will compare standard hospital discharge communication with discharge summaries simplified using ContextCare, an artificial intelligence-assisted application. The study will enroll 50 adults discharged from Scarborough Health Network. Participants will be assigned to one of two groups in a 1:1 ratio, with allocation stratified by baseline health literacy. The main measure is how well participants explain their diagnosis, treatment, follow-up care, and instructions for seeking further help immediately after receiving discharge information. The study will also assess satisfaction, recall after discharge, and selected post-discharge outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older.
* Medically stable for discharge.
* Completed discharge summary available.
* Independently able to participate in consent.
* Able to understand the consent form in English.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age younger than 18 years.
* Medical instability or acute illness preventing discharge.
* Has a legally authorized representative or substitute decision maker for conditions including, but not limited to, impaired vision and/or hearing or impaired speech.
* Discharge summary unavailable at the time of discharge.
